categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the optical disc manufacturing and related optical storage media products sector, including high-capacity Blu-ray discs and archival-grade storage media. It also engages in brand business under the Verbatim brand, offering diversified consumer electronics products such as SSDs, GaN chargers, power banks, and portable monitors. Additionally, the company has diversified investments in IoT, electric vehicles, entertainment, dining, and distribution sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced optical disc manufacturing technologies inherited from Mitsubishi, including chemical dye coating, inorganic sputtering, and mastering for high-capacity Blu-ray discs. It develops proprietary materials such as dyes and mastering techniques, focusing on high-quality, high-capacity, and archival-grade discs with certifications from international labs. Production processes include injection molding, metal sputtering, protective coating, and packaging, with continuous R&D on next-generation storage media and environmentally friendly packaging.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include government agencies, educational institutions, medical units, libraries, cloud data centers, and multimedia studios requiring archival and high-capacity storage solutions. The company serves B2B professional markets and consumer markets primarily in the Americas, Asia, Europe, and Japan. It also targets data centers for cold data storage and leverages the Verbatim brand to reach young consumers in Europe, the US, and Japan.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally with significant sales in the Americas (20%), Asia (32%), Europe (34%), domestic Taiwan (6%), and other regions (8%). It has production facilities in Taiwan and maintains a strong presence in major markets including the US, Europe, Japan, China, and the Asia-Pacific region. The company actively expands its market share in Japan and China, especially in high-capacity archival storage.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain as a manufacturer of optical storage media and related products. It sources raw materials such as plastics, dyes, and sputtering targets from upstream suppliers and sells finished products downstream to distributors, brand owners, and end consumers. It also holds licensing and technology partnerships with upstream technology providers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include accelerating product innovation, shortening time-to-market, and localizing product development to meet regional market needs. The company focuses on developing high-capacity archival-grade optical discs (300GB, 500GB, 1.5TB+), environmentally friendly packaging, and integrating AI storage technologies. It emphasizes sustainable development, energy efficiency, and expanding into AI and green new energy sectors through strategic investments.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through product sales of optical discs, storage media, and consumer electronics under the Verbatim brand. The company also earns licensing fees from technology and patent agreements. It leverages both physical retail and e-commerce channels globally to drive sales, with a focus on B2B contracts for archival storage and B2C sales for consumer electronics.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a leading global market share in optical disc manufacturing, surpassing 60% in key markets. It competes with other optical disc manufacturers and storage media providers but benefits from proprietary technology, strong brand recognition (Verbatim), and strategic partnerships with major international firms like Mitsubishi and Pioneer. The exit of competitors like Sony from certain markets has strengthened its position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$7.44 billion in the latest fiscal year, showing slight growth over the previous year. Despite a net loss due to increased investment valuation losses, it maintains a strong financial structure with a low debt ratio (31%) and high liquidity ratios. R&D investment increased to about 4.81% of revenue, reflecting a focus on innovation amid a mature industry.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, high-capacity, and archival-grade optical storage media with long data retention (over 50 years) certified by international labs. Its products offer superior data security, energy efficiency, and environmental friendliness compared to alternative storage media. The Verbatim brand is positioned as a trusted, innovative technology brand with strong customer loyalty, supported by proprietary materials and manufacturing expertise.
